title: Update on AI use in Chinese cement sector
summary: Update on AI use in Chinese cement sector
body_markdown:
**China:** Cement producers in China are accelerating the digitalisation and decarbonisation of their operations through AI applications, autonomous mining vehicles and CO₂ capture projects.


Anhui Conch Group has deployed driverless trucks at its quarries and developed an AI model with Huawei that covers more than 200 potential applications across 15 production categories. The producer has also introduced more than 40 AI applications, including clinker strength prediction and kiln optimisation models to reduce coal consumption. Conch operates a CO₂ capture and purification project at its Wuhu cement plant in Anhui, processing 50,000t/yr of kiln exhaust gas for industrial and food-grade applications.


Nearly 70 cement companies have received smart or intelligent manufacturing demonstration factory designations since 2021, according to former China Cement Association executive president Kong Xiangzhong.
